\section[(dialogue)]{Clothes and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R147-first-pass-clothes-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a wolf and a crow.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item peas, a cucumber, a mango, a banana, an apple
  \item grapes, an orange, a watermelon, a coconut, yoghurt
  \item butter, paneer, honey, a chilli, flour
  \item a samosa, lassi, juice, a mountain, a river
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Peas? (\textbf{\hi{मटर}}, \emph{maṭar}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\hi{खीरा}}, \emph{khīrā}.) A mango? (\textbf{\hi{आम}}, \emph{ām}.) A banana? (\textbf{\hi{केला}}, \emph{kelā}.) An apple? (\textbf{\hi{सेब}}, \emph{seb}.) Grapes? (\textbf{\hi{अंगूर}}, \emph{aṅgūr}.) An orange? (\textbf{\hi{संतरा}}, \emph{santarā}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\hi{तरबूज़}}, \emph{tarbūz}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\hi{नारियल}}, \emph{nāriyal}.) Yoghurt? (\textbf{\hi{दही}}, \emph{dahī}.) Butter? (\textbf{\hi{मक्खन}}, \emph{makkhan}.) Paneer? (\textbf{\hi{पनीर}}, \emph{panīr}.) Honey? (\textbf{\hi{शहद}}, \emph{śahad}.) A chilli? (\textbf{\hi{मिर्च}}, \emph{mirc}.) Flour? (\textbf{\hi{आटा}}, \emph{āṭā}.) A samosa? (\textbf{\hi{समोसा}}, \emph{samosā}.) Lassi? (\textbf{\hi{लस्सी}}, \emph{lassī}.) Juice? (\textbf{\hi{जूस}}, \emph{jūs}.) A mountain? (\textbf{\hi{पहाड़}}, \emph{pahāṛ}.) A river? (\textbf{\hi{नदी}}, \emph{nadī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food and nature — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R147-second-pass-food-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lake and the sea.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lake, the sea, a forest, a tree, a root
  \item a stone, sand, a wave, a shore, electricity; lightning
  \item a storm, fog, snow, wind, a lion
  \item a bear, an elephant, a camel, a donkey, a sheep
  \item a rabbit, a deer, a fox, a wolf, a crow
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lake? (\textbf{\hi{झील}}, \emph{jhīl}.) The sea? (\textbf{\hi{समुद्र}}, \emph{samudra}.) A forest? (\textbf{\hi{जंगल}}, \emph{jaṅgal}.) A tree? (\textbf{\hi{पेड़}}, \emph{peṛ}.) A root? (\textbf{\hi{जड़}}, \emph{jaṛ}.) A stone? (\textbf{\hi{पत्थर}}, \emph{patthar}.) Sand? (\textbf{\hi{रेत}}, \emph{ret}.) A wave? (\textbf{\hi{लहर}}, \emph{lahar}.) A shore? (\textbf{\hi{किनारा}}, \emph{kinārā}.) Electricity; lightning? (\textbf{\hi{बिजली}}, \emph{bijlī}.) A storm? (\textbf{\hi{आँधी}}, \emph{ā̃dhī}.) Fog? (\textbf{\hi{कोहरा}}, \emph{kohrā}.) Snow? (\textbf{\hi{बर्फ़}}, \emph{barf}.) Wind? (\textbf{\hi{हवा}}, \emph{havā}.) A lion? (\textbf{\hi{शेर}}, \emph{śer}.) A bear? (\textbf{\hi{भालू}}, \emph{bhālū}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\hi{हाथी}}, \emph{hāthī}.) A camel? (\textbf{\hi{ऊँट}}, \emph{ū̃ṭ}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\hi{गधा}}, \emph{gadhā}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\hi{भेड़}}, \emph{bheṛ}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\hi{खरगोश}}, \emph{khargoś}.) A deer? (\textbf{\hi{हिरन}}, \emph{hiran}.) A fox? (\textbf{\hi{लोमड़ी}}, \emph{lomṛī}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\hi{भेड़िया}}, \emph{bheṛiyā}.) A crow? (\textbf{\hi{कौआ}}, \emph{kauā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
